Our Mission Is To Supply All Of Our Customers On Time, Every Time And To The “Highest Quality Standards”.
about:
Cal-Chip Electronics, Inc. operates from Warminster, Pennsylvania, where it has built over 35 years of experience as a specialist in surface mounted devices. The company describes itself as a manufacturer and supplier of passive surface mount components, emphasizing a commitment to zero-defect quality and on-time delivery.

The company manufactures and stocks a broad range of passive surface mount components, including ceramic and polymer multilayer chip capacitors, tantalum and aluminum electrolytic capacitors, thick- and thin-film chip resistors, automotive-grade and current-sensing resistors, multilayer and wire-wound chip inductors, power inductors, and ferrite beads. Cal-Chip claims to be the largest stocking manufacturer of passive SMD components, with more than 200 billion units in inventory.

Cal-Chip serves the electronics manufacturing sector, particularly companies producing printed circuit boards for commercial, automotive, and other applications that require high-density surface mount assemblies. Its product range includes automotive-grade resistors and other components qualified for demanding environments.

The company states that its mission is to supply customers on time, every time, to the highest quality standards, backed by competitive pricing and responsive support. It highlights its three-decade focus on surface mount technology as a foundation for its ability to meet evolving component demands.
